comments.text:
This greed is why I stopped going to the Vegas strip over a decade ago.  The Golden Age of Vegas ended around 20 years ago.  Once it went purely public corporate, everything went shortsighted and ultra greedy.  I refuse to pay for parking FULL STOP!

Fortunately, I don't gamble, so I have no addiction to what Casinos peddle, but the free entertainment used to be first rate, and especially at the Casinos off the strip.  But now even that is gone.

Personally, I think that gambling is stupid, but to each their own.  Most habitual gamblers that I have personally known, ruined their lives because of their addiction.  Very sad and pathetic.

Here's the thing about gamblers, they will always tell you about their wins, but never the tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands, that they have lost.

If you are not so rich that you have tens of thousands of dollars to throw away, then Vegas is not your friend, and especially for the past 20 years.  Vegas doesn't care about working and middle class Americans, they now cater exclusively to the rich.
